TRACKER_ENHANCEMENTS.setting.reflow.desc: If initiatives are tied, renumber the encounter in the requested order using consecutive integers. This replaces decimal tie breakers.
TRACKER_ENHANCEMENTS.setting.showHPForTy: World setting, shared by all players. Configure under your own GM account. All combatants shows every valid HP circle in the tracker. Actor-type choices add that type to normal token visibility; Bar Brawl visibility rules still apply.
TRACKER_ENHANCEMENTS.setting.enableHpFie: Enable an editable HP field in the combat tracker for GMs and actor owners.
TRACKER_ENHANCEMENTS.setting.enableHpRad: Enables HP circles on combat tracker portraits. Players follow Player HP circle visibility and token Bar 1 visibility; GMs always see valid circles when enabled. Bar Brawl visibility rules still apply.
TRACKER_ENHANCEMENTS.setting.removeTarge: Clear your targets when the active encounter changes turn or round, or ends. Applies immediately without reloading.
TRACKER_ENHANCEMENTS.setting.hideNonAlly: Hide non-ally initiative from players on FVTT combat tracker
TRACKER_ENHANCEMENTS.hp.label: HP
TRACKER_ENHANCEMENTS.invalidHp: Enter a number or a signed change such as -10 or +3.
TRACKER_ENHANCEMENTS.updateFailed: The update failed. Check permissions and the browser console for details.
TRACKER_ENHANCEMENTS.rollInitiativeFirst: Roll or enter initiative for all combatants before reordering.
TRACKER_ENHANCEMENTS.initiativeReflowReq: These initiatives are tied. Enable initiative reflow to place a combatant between them.
TRACKER_ENHANCEMENTS.unsupportedTurnOrde: This system uses a custom turn order that cannot be rearranged by initiative.
TRACKER_ENHANCEMENTS.groupInitiative: Change this group's shared initiative using the system's group controls.
TRACKER_ENHANCEMENTS.migrationFailed: Some previous settings could not be copied. Review Tracker Enhancements settings; details are in the browser console. The original settings have been kept.
